1522801.name: Hand of Salvation
1522801.description: Attacks with its tentacles, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1522803.name: Cutting Words
1522803.description:
Fires multiple projectiles from its mouth, dealing damage to Nikkes.
Projectiles can be intercepted.

1522804.name: Wandering Salvation
1522804.description: Fires a burst of energy from its mouth, dealing damage to Nikkes.

1522805.name: Choice of Salvation
1522805.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1522806.name: Baptism Ceremony
1522806.description: Covers its whole body in slime, significantly increasing the DEF of all parts except Cancel Rings.

1522808.name: Words of Salvation
1522808.description: Fires projectiles from its mouth, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act.

1522809.name: Embrace of Salvation
1522809.description: Gathers its tentacles and swings them with great force, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1522810.name: Breath of Salvation
1522810.description: Spews gas, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1522813.name: Noxious Breath of Salvation
1522813.description: Spews a large amount of gas, dealing massive damage to all Nikkes. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals massive damage to all Nikkes.
